mode_meaning.C: navigation, transit arrivals and delays, traffic and road closures, ride arrival, flight gates and delays, urgent calls or messages from family and VIPs
mode_meaning.F: meeting pings, deadlines, build and deploy failures, production incidents, manager escalations, calendar reminders
mode_meaning.D: critical safety emergencies, hospital and emergency-services contact, urgent family distress, critical alarms such as smoke or intrusion
mode_meaning.S: family distress, school emergencies, medical notifications, immediate-family urgent messages, vital health alerts, critical alarms
mode_meaning.W: workout timer and interval completion, fitness and health-tracking alerts, emergency broadcasts

rules: A label is the set of modes in which the notification must be SHOWN. In every other mode it must be MUTED. An empty set means Muted everywhere.
Judge the notification by what it says AND where it comes from (the app and sender). The same words can be urgent from one app and spam from another.
Public emergencies (storms, earthquakes, tsunamis, floods, wildfire, amber alerts, gas or chemical leaks, smoke or fire alarms) are urgent in ALL five modes.
Promotions, scams, recommendations, subscriptions, social activity, games, news digests and routine system messages are Muted in every mode, even when they use urgent-sounding words (near-miss).
Family distress (accident, hospital, 'call me now', someone is in danger) is urgent in Commute, Do Not Disturb and Sleeping. Routine family chat (errands, 'reached home') is Muted.
Calls: a missed call from an immediate family member is urgent in Commute, Do Not Disturb and Sleeping. Calls from unknown numbers, spam-likely callers, scam callers and ordinary contacts are Muted.
Workplace urgency (incident, build failure, deadline, meeting starting, manager escalation) is urgent in Deep Work / Focus only.
Navigation, transit, ride arrival, flight gate and delay, and road closure notices are urgent in Commute only.
Workout intervals, timers and step or goal completion are urgent in Workout / Gym only; a critical heart or health alert is urgent in Do Not Disturb, Sleeping and Workout.
OTP, verification codes and security or fraud alerts are NOT part of this dataset: the exceptions layer handles them. Do not write them.
No real personal data. Names are fictional, phone numbers use reserved fictional ranges or X masks, emails and links use example.com, example.org or .invalid.

difficulty.easy: Clear examples of the use case, one obvious label
difficulty.hard_negative: Looks urgent but is routine or promotional (storm sale, 'urgent offer', fake emergency)
difficulty.near_miss: Close to an urgent use case but missing the key cue or from the wrong sender (a friend's missed call, a doorbell sound)
